Olmsted County Courthouse – MN Courts

Welcome to Olmsted County Court, where justice is served, and the rule of law prevails. In this article, we will delve into the workings of the Olmsted County Court, its history, organization, key functions, and the various court divisions that make it a crucial pillar of the justice system in Olmsted County. Whether you are a resident seeking information or simply curious about the judicial system, this article will provide you with valuable insights into the Olmsted County Court.

The Olmsted County District Court, situated at the Olmsted County Government Center in Rochester, MN, is a crucial institution within the Minnesota State Court system. It serves as the primary trial court for various civil, criminal, family, and probate cases in Olmsted County. This article explores the Olmsted County District Court, its services, and the wealth of online resources available to the public.

Location and Contact Information

The Olmsted County District Court is conveniently located at: 151 4th Street SE, Rochester, MN 55904. For general inquiries, you can contact the court at:

  • Phone: 507-206-2400
  • Fax: 507-285-8996

Online Court Resources

The Olmsted County District Court provides online resources that benefit both legal professionals and the general public. These resources are accessible through the court's official website and encompass a wide range of legal information and services.
